descriptions.XLM: Soroban wrapper for native XLM so contracts can treat it as a fungible token.
descriptions.BLND: Blend governance / reward token used across the lending ecosystem.
descriptions.GEKO: Fungible Geko utility token for rewards, staking, and incentives.
descriptions.USDC: Wrapped USDC stablecoin available on Stellar testnet.
descriptions.wETH: Wrapped Ethereum asset for cross-asset experiments.
descriptions.wBTC: Wrapped Bitcoin asset used as an additional reserve.
descriptions.cometFactory: Factory contract that deploys Blend Comet strategy instances.
descriptions.comet: Deployed Comet strategy referenced by Blend automation.
descriptions.oracle: Price oracle providing reserve prices to the Blend pool.
descriptions.oraclemock: Oracle mock; mirrors the oracle address for testing scenarios.
descriptions.emitter: Emission distributor responsible for reward flows in the Blend pool.
descriptions.poolFactoryV2: Factory that can instantiate new Blend V2 lending pools.
descriptions.backstopV2: Backstop module absorbing bad debt and taking a fee from interest.
descriptions.TestnetV2: Reference Blend pool deployment used as baseline / template.
descriptions.Geko-Pool: Custom Blend pool for Geko (reserves: XLM, USDC, GEKO).
descriptions.Geko-Envelopes: Envelope manager that routes deposits/withdrawals through the Blend pool.
